sessionStart.bash: r='${PLUGIN_ROOT}'; case "$r" in '$'*) h="$COPILOT_HOME"; [ -n "$h" ] || h="$HOME/.copilot"; s="$h/hooks/scripts";; *) s="$r/com.github.copilot/hooks/scripts";; esac; exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File "$s/inject-git-conventions.ps1"

subagentStart.bash: r='${PLUGIN_ROOT}'; case "$r" in '$'*) h="$COPILOT_HOME"; [ -n "$h" ] || h="$HOME/.copilot"; s="$h/hooks/scripts";; *) s="$r/com.github.copilot/hooks/scripts";; esac; exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File "$s/inject-git-conventions.ps1"

preToolUse.bash: r='${PLUGIN_ROOT}'; case "$r" in '$'*) h="$COPILOT_HOME"; [ -n "$h" ] || h="$HOME/.copilot"; s="$h/hooks/scripts";; *) s="$r/com.github.copilot/hooks/scripts";; esac; exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File "$s/enforce-git-conventions.ps1"
